content.short: Ubik Capital is a Proof of Stake service provider, validator, and investor.
content.description: Ubik Capital is a trusted staking provider with years of industry experience, dedicated to securing major networks. It offers staking as a service and makes investments in diverse blockchain projects, leveraging proven expertise to support network infrastructure and development. Ubik Capital operates across Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Multichain, and BNB Chain, delivering reliable stake management and strategic investments to advance these ecosystems.
